MR6D_authority.documented: Validation capture uses RealSense D435i at30FPS and VICON camera tracking. Eye-in-hand maps camera MoCap to its optical frame. Static object placement is manually refined against a trajectory-assembled cloud, then projected perframe. Euro mesh is manually designed; real nominal dimensions may vary by centimeters. Authors expect static annotation accuracy in the low-centimeter range from process and visual checks.
not_certified_by_this_text: RGB-versus-depth optical-frame choice, exact depth-to-color export/reprojection or resampling implementation.
Synchronization settings, raw capture filters/hole-fill, per-pixel alignment uncertainty or exact depth PNG processing history.
A numerical pixel/part boundary bound or a sensor-depth accuracy bound.
MR6D_authority.release_card_limit: The reviewed release card says README content is empty. No capture/export authority was found in the reviewed paper/card; this is not proof that no author-held code exists.
MR6D_authority.CVF_PDF_fetch: Official conference PDF URL returned403 on direct open; author arXiv HTML supplied readable primary text.

BOP_normative_contract.fact: Per-frame depth_scale converts stored depth to mm. misc.Precomputer/depth_im_to_dist_im defines input depth as camera-axis Z at integer pixel coordinates and converts it to Euclidean range. This is the format/toolkit convention used by the frozen probe, not an independent reconstruction of MR6D capture history.

RealSense_device_and_SDK_authority.fact: The official device document distinguishes Z depth from Euclidean distance. Depth/color have separate sensor frames and intrinsics/extrinsics. Stream alignment is a separate operation, may have holes and pixel splatting, and does not follow merely from equal dimensions.
RealSense_device_and_SDK_authority.SDK_fact: Z16 units are sensor-specific and queried via depth_scale; zero means missing. Integer(0,0) is the top-left pixel center. Default device units are not a substitute for supplied per-frame dataset scale.
RealSense_device_and_SDK_authority.SDK_align_fact: The reviewed generic align implementation transforms/project depth-pixel corners to another viewport but transfers the original z16 sample (minimum original sample on collisions). Thus an aligned image alone does not certify recomputed color-optical-axis Z.
RealSense_device_and_SDK_authority.authority_limit: Current official SDK code/doc is general primary evidence, not the pinned SDK version or exporter used for MR6D. No assertion that MR6D used this path.

conclusion.source_depth_interpretation: Frozen supplied-depth_scale/Z comparison remains unchanged. Exact released MR6D RGB/depth processing and optical-frame provenance remain UNCONFIRMED by reviewed dataset-specific documents.
conclusion.residual_interpretation: No residual-driven switch to range, scale, offset, intrinsics, pose, mesh, pixel convention, tolerance, or mask mode. Signed residual and missing partitions remain measurements; cause is unresolved.
conclusion.mask_interpretation: A high target-alone/full-mask overlap does not independently certify sensor/RGB registration, exact visible part or native8 correspondence. Supplied masks/poses retain their original authority.
conclusion.safe_documentary_followup: If needed, inspect author-provided capture/export configuration or documented depth-alignment provenance without tuning against these observed residuals. This does not impose a new physical-corner certification requirement on the user task.
